label: Guide me: My return

params.name: lede
params.default: Your own return, ITR-1 or ITR-2: drop in your documents, and {product} reads them, checks them against each other and works out both regimes.
params.label: lede

default.title: Five steps
default.say: Gather, check, choose, review, file. Each step ticks itself off as it is done, and you can click any step to go back to it.

default.title: Drop in your documents
default.say: Start with the pre-filled JSON from the e-filing portal, then the AIS and Form 16 from each employer. A locked PDF opens with your PAN and date of birth.

default.title: What each one gave
default.say: Every document shows what was read from it - salary, tax deducted, interest - and, if you do not have it yet, how to get it.

default.title: Your return at a glance
default.say: Total income, tax, and the refund due or the amount to pay - kept up to date with every document and every figure.

default.title: Do the documents agree?
default.say: Form 16's tax deducted beside 26AS, and salary and interest beside the AIS. A gap is shown to you before the department finds it.

default.title: New or old regime
default.say: Both regimes worked out side by side, and the cheaper one marked. After the due date only the new regime is open, and the screen says so.

default.title: From income to tax
default.say: Income, what comes off it, what is taxed and the tax - the whole computation in one picture.

default.title: Review every figure
default.say: Each figure carries the document it came from. Type over any of them; your figure wins, and is marked as yours.

default.title: File it
default.say: ITR-1 or ITR-2 is picked for you, and the return is checked against the department's own schema. Download it and upload it on the e-filing portal.

description_nl: 2026-10-06: the My return walk - the five steps, the documents, the checks, the two regimes, the review and the file; tours/sf-myreturn.json says the same.
